meta.disclaimer: Historical incident literacy. Educational summaries only. SubjectIds reference shared cy_* entities — no duplicate campaign models.

incidents.title: WannaCry ransomware wave (2017)
incidents.background: A widely reported ransomware event associated in public literacy with EternalBlue-era Windows SMB exposure.
lessonsLearned: Deferred platform patches create shared risk
Network exposure amplifies wormable defects
Backups and segmentation limit blast radius
incidents.longTermImpact: Became a lasting teaching case for patch latency and ransomware preparedness.

incidents.title: NotPetya disruption (2017)
incidents.background: A destructive event often discussed alongside EternalBlue-era exposure — educational continental awareness, not precise victim mapping.
lessonsLearned: Not all ‘ransomware’ is primarily for ransom
Recovery planning matters as much as prevention
Trusted internal propagation paths can be abused
incidents.longTermImpact: Strengthened global conversation about destructive malware vs crimeware.

incidents.title: SolarWinds supply-chain compromise (literacy)
incidents.background: Public discourse around Orion-related supply-chain compromise elevated vendor trust and update integrity as first-class concerns.
lessonsLearned: Update channels are high-value trust surfaces
Inventory of vendor software is strategic
Detection and recovery planning must assume trusted pipes can fail
incidents.longTermImpact: Normalized supply-chain risk in board and public conversations.

incidents.title: Log4Shell disclosure wave (2021)
incidents.background: A critical Log4j 2 vulnerability disclosure that forced worldwide dependency inventory conversations.
lessonsLearned: Transitive dependencies hide risk
SBOMs and inventory beat panic scanning theater
Vendor guidance should be read calmly and completely
incidents.longTermImpact: Permanent shift toward dependency awareness in developer security.

incidents.title: MOVEit exploitation campaigns (2023 literacy)
incidents.background: Public campaigns around Progress MOVEit Transfer vulnerabilities highlighted file-transfer exposure in enterprises.
lessonsLearned: Niche enterprise apps can be high-impact
Internet-facing file transfer needs urgent patch discipline
incidents.longTermImpact: Reinforced attention on managed file-transfer estates.

incidents.title: Large public cloud outage awareness (placeholder literacy)
incidents.background: Cloud outage days may dominate headlines while vulnerability volume is quiet. This record teaches resilience literacy without inventing a specific outage.
lessonsLearned: Map critical dependencies
Status pages and communication plans matter
Backups and multi-region thinking are resilience, not panic
incidents.longTermImpact: Keeps outage seasons in the knowledge library without fabricating incidents.

incidents.title: Heartbleed disclosure (2014)
incidents.background: OpenSSL heartbeat memory disclosure that forced global certificate and key rotation conversations.
lessonsLearned: Crypto libraries are infrastructure
Disclosure coordination shapes public trust
Rotation and patching are twin responses
incidents.longTermImpact: Canonical example in vulnerability history courses.
